verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an official desktop app, OS-level keyboard shortcuts, or the ability to see what is on the user's screen. The related items fall short: Vision analyzes uploaded images, Browse with Copilot acts only inside the Edge browser, connectors are listed for Copilot.com and mobile only, and a community comment mentions a 'standalone ... app' without describing desktop shortcuts or screen access.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can use an official desktop app with OS-level shortcuts and access to what is on my screen
